newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent hits day's low as US crude breaks suppor.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent hits day's low as US crude breaks suppor.

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures hit a session low in mid-afternoon as selling on NYMEX crude by one Wall Street dealer took the market through technical support levels.
April Brent was trading 18 cents down at $19.40 a barrel at 1643 GMT.
"(NYMEX crude) broke through the pivot number at $21.08 and then broke some short-term sell signs," said one IPE floor dealer. "We've been coming off in light volume."
But brokers said that they did not see much more downside potential for April Brent.
"There's still a feeling that the market is oversold. The funds are still short and they'll need to come in and cover," said one.
IPE March gas oil was trading $1.50 lower at $164.25 a tonne.
